name: International Flavors & Fragrances
description: IFF is a business-to-business ingredient maker: it creates and sells the flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and enzymes inside other companies' soft drinks, snacks, perfumes, detergents and supplements. Customers are mostly multinational consumer-products firms (the 25 largest were about 32% of 2025 sales), who buy custom compounds under ongoing supply relationships. It is shrinking by design: it sold the Pharma Solutions unit and others in 2025, sold its soy crush business in March 2026, and on May 29, 2026 agreed to sell most of Food Ingredients (its largest segment, 30% of 2025 sales) to CVC Capital Partners while keeping a 10% stake. It lost $361M in 2025 after a $1.153B goodwill write-down on Food Ingredients.

businessLines.name: Taste
businessLines.how: Custom flavor formulas sold by weight to food and beverage makers on repeat orders; the customer reformulates rarely, so supply is sticky.
businessLines.description: Flavor compounds and natural taste solutions for savory foods, beverages, sweets and dairy, plus value-added spices.

operatingProfit.note: segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA (before D&A), 19.3% of segment sales

businessLines.name: Food Ingredients
businessLines.how: Commodity-linked ingredient sales by weight to food manufacturers; lower margin than Taste and Scent.
businessLines.description: Natural, artificial and plant-based specialty food ingredients: emulsifiers, sweeteners, texturants, natural food protection, soy and pea protein. Being sold: SCL (soy crush, concentrates, lecithin) divested 2026-03-02; remaining Food Ingredients disposal group agreed to be sold to CVC on 2026-05-29.

operatingProfit.note: segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA (before D&A), 12.9% of segment sales

businessLines.name: Health & Biosciences
businessLines.how: Sold by weight or activity unit to food, detergent, feed and ethanol producers; patented strains and enzymes with repeat usage.
businessLines.description: Biotech-derived enzymes, food cultures, probiotics: Health, Food Biosciences, Home & Personal Care (detergent enzymes), Animal Nutrition, grain processing and brewing.

operatingProfit.note: segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA (before D&A), 26.0% of segment sales

businessLines.name: Scent
businessLines.how: Custom fragrance formulas sold by weight to perfume, household and personal-care brands; ingredients sold to other fragrance houses.
businessLines.description: Fragrance compounds (fine and consumer fragrance), fragrance ingredients and cosmetic actives.

operatingProfit.note: segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA (before D&A), 20.8% of segment sales

businessLines.how: Ingredient sales to drug makers; business sold, so FY2025 reflects only about five months.

operatingProfit.note: segment Adjusted Operating EBITDA, 20.6% of segment sales
